HeldAccount.description: An account covered by a hold. This structure is immutable. It can be an individual account or a Google Group, depending on the service. To work with Vault resources, the account must have the [required Vault privileges] (https://support.google.com/vault/answer/2799699) and access to the matter. To access a matter, the account must have created the matter, have the matter shared with them, or have the **View All Matters** privilege.

includeSharedDrives.description: Set to **true** to include shared drives.

enumDescriptions: No shared drive option specified.
If a resource is in a shared drive, it isn't included in the search.

Shared drive resources are only included in instances where the account is a collaborator on a resource but they are not a member of the shared drive. This maps to the *"Included only if documents shared directly (not due to shared drive membership)"* option in the Vault UI. (Previously "include_shared_drives" off)
Resources in shared drives are included in the search. (Previously "include_shared_drives" on)
sharedDrivesOption.description: Optional. Options to include or exclude documents in shared drives. We recommend using this field over include_shared_drives. This field overrides include_shared_drives and include_team_drives when set.
